title: Elite Dangerous (Odyssey)
provenance: Reported by kurimanju-dev (highball-db#503, 2026-10-15), Apple M1 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.16, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, D3DMetal, recipes steam and vcrun2022, rated 5 of 5: flawless from the launcher into the game, Ultra at 1080p, 60 fps and more in space, 40 to 50 in a station. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported flawless on D3DMetal on the default engine, from Frontier's launcher into the game. The reporter says switching the environment to D3DMetal improved performance and loading times substantially over the mode they had before. Ultra settings at 1080p: 60 fps and more in space, 40 to 50 in a space station, on an M1 Pro. Odyssey is an expansion of Elite Dangerous (Steam 359320), so this page is the base game's too (the reporter, 2026-10-19).

knownIssues.symptom: A HOTAS or other flight stick is not seen by the game
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed here. SDL_JOYSTICK_MFI=0 turns off SDL's Game Controller framework driver, which points at that driver taking the device
knownIssues.fix: add SDL_JOYSTICK_MFI=0 to the environment's variables (Environment settings, Advanced), reported by kurimanju-dev (highball-db#503, 2026-10-19), not tried here
